en.title: Deposit and Withdrawal at NUTS: Step-by-Step via Telegram Bot — Nuts PPPoker
en.description: How to deposit and withdraw at the NUTS club on PPPoker: @NUTS111777_bot, manager @NUTSsup, cards, SBP, crypto. Step-by-step guide and FAQ.
en.bodyHtml:
Author: Marina «Cap» Tsvetkova, CFO at NUTS

Published: November 2026

Two channels work: the Telegram bot and your manager. Both are fast and transparent. Here is the full walkthrough.

Before your first transfer

  • Joined club 111777 — join guide
  • Your PPPoker User ID
  • Min deposit usually from $10

Option 1: @NUTS111777_bot (recommended)

  1. Open @NUTS111777_bot
  2. Choose Deposit or Withdraw
  3. Enter amount — bot shows the rate
  4. Pay via card, SBP, or crypto
  5. Chips arrive in minutes

Option 2: manager @NUTSsup

For bonuses, custom payment methods, or if the bot is down — @NUTSsup. Send User ID + amount. Support 24/7.

Security

Pay only via the official bot or @NUTSsup. NUTS never asks for your PPPoker password. See also rakeback & bonuses.
